project_context: Securly Filter — India PM baseline for Dev / Manual QA / Automation subtask estimates
recommended_jql_template:
Replace SPRINT_NAME and adjust for your Jira sprint field syntax.
Example patterns:
  sprint = "sprint-Arthur" AND statusCategory = Done
  "Sprint" in ("sprint-Arthur") AND status in (Done, Closed)
  Sprint in (12345)  -- if using sprint id from board
export_fields_note: Capture all fields needed for lossless analysis: key, issuetype, parent, subtasks, summary, status, resolution, resolutiondate, created, updated, assignee, reporter, priority, labels, components, fixVersions, Sprint, timeoriginalestimate, timeestimate, aggregatetimeoriginalestimate, aggregatetimeestimate, timespent, aggregatetimespent, workratio, description, issuelinks, comment (optional), plus story points custom field id for your site.
format_rules: One line = one JSON object (single Jira issue REST payload or normalized row).
Do not strip description or changelog if you need auditability; use .jsonl + zip for size.
After export, set last_full_export_utc (ISO-8601) and issue_counts_per_file.
